  type. The prepared owner zeros all fields, classifies immutable selectors,
  and existing style copy/rebuild/remove/index paths keep their ownership.
  style.c, libs/wild.c, modules and native/Perl packet definitions are unchanged.
- Escaped masks are separate from literal/unescaped/fixed-width overlap masks.
  Existing exact/minimum/position/member overlap proofs cannot mistake decoded
  widths or star offsets for their unescaped raw spans. Escaped selectors stay
  in their existing conservative index fallback unless an independent predicate
  indexes the conjunction. Configuration parsing and quoting layers are unchanged.
- Preparation counts one decoded byte per literal/question/quoted byte and zero
  for each unquoted star. A trailing backslash counts an impossible literal slot;
  span/cursor paths refuse its terminator without reading beyond it. Prepared
  widths are bounded by the NUL-terminated selector's raw allocation.
- Fixed matching requires exact decoded width. Single-star matching first requires
  length >= minimum, then splits minimum into before/after decoded widths. This
  prevents underflow and span overlap. The raw star offset points after the only
  unquoted star; quoted stars cannot be separators. No new pointer is retained.
- General matching consumes literal/quoted/question tokens or advances the latest
  star's retry value. While the current value is non-NUL, retry_value is no later
  than it, so one increment can reach the terminator but cannot pass it. Consecutive
  stars advance only the pattern. No recursive call occurs in the new cursor.
  Exhaustion accepts only end-of-pattern or one raw final star, preserving the
  legacy empty-tail and quoted-star behavior. Retries can revisit spans.
- The lazy subject length is shared only during one existing borrowed identity.
  New fields do not change subject size or survive command mutation/destruction.
  No X/dispatch/update/grab/resource/lifetime barrier changes. Metadata grows
  sixteen inline bytes (168 -> 184); existing style allocations/copies can therefore
  grow too. New escaped paths can add one lazy full-value length scan per field
  per lookup; prefix mismatches still reject first. No separate heap buffer or
  session-memory/latency reduction is claimed.

  checks remain. New escaped short-form oracle includes literal '*'/'?'/'\\'
  subjects and trailing escapes. Closed-form deep tests avoid calling the recursive
  oracle on a matching deep stack. Actual-core normal/reference/collision streams
  compare complete initialized results and restore defaults after removal.

  cases. The unchanged baseline emits nine one-call rows; candidate normal/collision
  rows emit zero with unchanged hits/misses. No registration/deadline was weakened.
- The combined checkpoint raw archives validate; owning checks pass. IMAGE-01's known
